title: THREE LANGUAGES, ONE PAGE
rule: the home page exists in English, Shqip and Arabic; the switch re-sets the whole page live, and Arabic mirrors the layout right to left for real (dir=rtl, logical properties), so the page proves the right-to-left skill by being one
description: Concept C3. The first screen: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps.' at 64 px, the level line 'Part of two platform rewrites. 5+ years, based in Kosovo, working remotely.' at 24 px, then 'This page also reads in' with the same identity line in the two other languages as buttons; the one that changes direction says so ('right to left'). Beside them, two public Bayyinah TV captures of the same library page: the laptop view and a flat phone-width capture (no device frame); at phone width only the phone capture shows. Below: six rows with a result line and the languages each app shipped in, each language name in its own script, no rules between rows. Then 'In Albanian': FJALË and a flat crop of the Viva Fresh home screen. Then 'His own products': Offday (light, about 200 automatic tests, code private), OFFBEAT and FORM labelled 'Concept' with GitHub links. Footer with email, GitHub, LinkedIn and the CV. The Arabic switch mirrors the whole layout in three stages (header, columns, rows; 480 ms).
signature: Type: one family name, two scripts. Literata (opsz 7-72, wght 400-600, subset 75 kB) for Latin and Albanian; Amiri Regular and Bold (Arabic subsets, 41 kB each) for Arabic, joined by unicode-range and size-adjusted 122% so an Arabic word sits at the size of a Latin word on the same line. Identity line 64 px Literata 500 at opsz 64, -0.025 em; Arabic 56 px Amiri Bold, line-height 1.5, never tracked. Arabic-Indic digits for Arabic years. No mono. Colour: a manuscript palette, ultramarine ground #1A2466, vellum text #F2EADB (11.8:1), gold #E0B252 for the active language, language names and link underlines (7.2:1), muted #C3C6E0 (8.4:1). Motion: one View Transition of 320 ms on cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); about 50 named parts move from their old box to their mirrored box, old text fades out in 200 ms, new text fades in from 140 to 320 ms, captures move as objects and never cross-fade, the root never fades, the header stays on top, and the block the reader is on keeps its height on screen. The chosen alternate line grows into the headline while the old headline shrinks into its place. Reduced motion: instant switch. The language is in the URL (?lang=sq, ?lang=ar), on html lang and dir, and in the document title.
mechanisms: live right-to-left mirror of the whole layout
one fact in three scripts as the language switch
language names in their own scripts as row data
hook: His site flips into Arabic for real: the header, then the columns, then the rows slide to the other side and the page reads right to left.
holdback: Lowest: actions and seniority, 7 to 8. The level line is now 24 px under the name, but the platform depth is still one line and the row roles. No public Arabic Bayyinah TV page exists: bayyinahtv.com shows no language switch and no rtl markup to a visitor who is not signed in (checked on the home and /library/arabic pages and in the public bundles), and bayyinah.org has no Arabic page. So the hero shows the English interface, and the page no longer claims anything the captures cannot prove: the identity line says what he builds, the Arabic claim stays as text in the Bayyinah TV row (CONTENT §3), and the page itself shows the right-to-left skill. Every Albanian and Arabic string is listed in translationsToCheck for the owner and a native reader; the page does not mark them. The in-app browser pane was hidden, so the live click there switched with no transition; the mirror is proven headless in real time at 0.04 playback rate.
translationsNote: Every Albanian and Arabic string that differs from English, generated from copy.ts. Strings that are the same in all three languages (product names, App Store, Google Play, Latin years) are not listed. The owner checks the Albanian and a native reader checks the Arabic before the page is public.

craft.cls: 0 at 1440, 1280, 1024, 540, 390 and 375 in en and ar, on load and after a fast scroll to the bottom (round 10b probe)
craft.targets: every link and button is at least 44 x 44 px (0 smaller at every width)
craft.focus: 2 px gold ring, 3 px offset, on every link and button
craft.hover: hover only adds a tint or underline; every action has a visible control
craft.reducedMotion: switch is instant: 0 animations 16 ms after the click, dir already rtl
craft.noWebGL: no WebGL, no canvas, no sound
craft.chunk: Draft chunk 8.1 kB gzip in a production build
craft.fontWait: render waits at most 300 ms; late faces fall back to a sized Georgia and Geeza Pro for the whole visit
craft.images: no capture above its pixels on a 2x screen (largest scale 1.00); Offday 0.70, OFFBEAT 0.50, FORM 0.46 at 1440

checks: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json: no error in src/drafts/four-languages (other drafts in progress have errors). npx oxlint src/drafts/four-languages: clean.

fixed: Right-to-left proof: searched bayyinahtv.com (home, /ar, ?lang=ar, /library/arabic, all public bundles) and bayyinah.org; no public Arabic interface exists without a login, so no Arabic capture was made or invented. The hero caption no longer argues against itself ('These captures show the English one' removed); it says what the pictures show: 'Bayyinah TV library, Arabic courses tab. Public pages.' (devil 1, critic 3)

Claim: 'builds web and mobile apps in the user's own language' replaced with 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps.' plus 'This page also reads in', and a 'right to left' note on the button that flips direction; the page proves it on press (devil 2)
